spec-create.description: Create a new technical specification with auto-incremented ID
spec-create.template: Use the spec-manager skill to create a new spec. Ask the user for the title/requirement, then: 1) Check docs/specs/README.md for the last ID used, 2) Create a new file in docs/specs/ using the next sequential ID (SPEC-XXX format), 3) Copy the template from docs/specs/templates/spec-template.md, 4) Research the requirement if needed, 5) Fill in the template with the requirement details, 6) Update docs/specs/README.md to add the new spec to the index and update counters, 7) Report back the created spec ID and summary. Remember iHost constraints: low memory, SQLite, minimal dependencies.

spec-list.description: List all specs with optional status filter
spec-list.template: Read docs/specs/README.md and report the current status of all specs. If the user provided a status argument, filter by that status. Include the counter summary.

spec-status.description: Update the status of a specific spec
spec-status.template: Update the status of a spec. Arguments: spec ID and new status. Steps: 1) Read the spec file from docs/specs/, 2) Validate the status transition is allowed (draft→pending_execution→in_progress→pending_release→released), 3) Update the frontmatter status in the spec file, 4) Update the status in docs/specs/README.md, 5) Add an entry to the spec's change history, 6) Confirm the update.

spec-show.description: Show summary of a specific spec
spec-show.template: Read the spec file from docs/specs/ and provide a concise summary: ID, title, status, requirements, acceptance criteria, and current progress.
